title: Nice quality, well made and looks great!
text:
Nice quality, well made and looks great!. The chair arrived in great condition. The legs were easy to put on. It's a firm cushion, but it is comfortable. It looks nice and it is good quality.
I did receive this item from vine. I would have chosen gray instead of denim, if I had the choice. It's going to look great in our guest room.
